_readme: Branch -> LOCAL database map. Read ONLY when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development
and only when a .git directory is present, so it is inert in a published deploy.
Checking out a branch is all it takes to switch database - nothing to edit.
Holds NO secret: every entry is Windows-authenticated against a local SQL Server
instance, which is why this file is tracked in git.
Keep this file IDENTICAL on every branch. It lists all of them, so it never
conflicts on a merge or a cherry-pick between the three production lines.
